scope: Read-only Activity and Host route inventory; concrete findings/proposed boundaries, not product remediation or full UX acceptance

fixture_contracts.event: model.Event: int64 sequence, type/entity strings, RFC3339 at, arbitrary JSON data; exact large integers use BigInt/stringifyJSON
fixture_contracts.status: model.Status plus namedStatus response display_name; known/null/empty capabilities and infrastructure slices
fixture_contracts.ports: model.PortBinding/PortClaim: tcp4/documentation-range addresses/hold/infrastructure state; synthetic detail strings
fixture_contracts.initial_journal: 200 events arrive between initial status snapshot and catch-up; published manager limit256, client retains200. No fabricated already-known cursor is bypassed.
fixture_contracts.local_host_metadata_boundary: The local Host route does not call node_metadata or render NodeMetadata platform/inventory fields; no such discovery/data was added.
fixture_contracts.mutations: Backend strict read allowlist plus in-memory subscriptions; every other operation, including inspect, refuses. Clipboard/socket/API paths are blocked.

execution.interpretation: Collection/safety completion does not turn the negative Code/reader/header results into passing visual regressions.

prioritized_findings.evidence: All four cases show26 capability identifiers (expected1073 characters) and8 ports (expected3409 JSON characters), but both native Code text lengths are0.23 known-feature prose labels confirm populated status reached the route.
prioritized_findings.cause: main renderHost uses technical.set({code:...}) and infrastructure.set({code:...}); graph-ui maps code to c:code. Native codeRun reads c:label then c:value. Initial c:value remains empty.
prioritized_findings.proposed_exact_boundary: Only the two renderHost setters should use value, retaining current data/stringifyJSON/display cap. Reproduce metadata presentation after this binding correction before allocating any layout style. No global graph-ui Code mapping change.
prioritized_findings.acceptance: Not implemented or authorized by this inventory

prioritized_findings.area: Activity refresh replaces the open selected exact reader and loses focus
prioritized_findings.evidence: At every viewport, duplicate replay and a new durable Event leave page2 and selected int64 sequence intact but disconnect the original Exact event record button, lose its focus and close the replacement disclosure. Native page/Choice nodes and focused Choice survive separately.
prioritized_findings.cause: renderActivity always calls renderEventDetail; renderEventDetail replaces description/disclosure handles each time, including status refresh and an identical selected record.
prioritized_findings.proposed_exact_boundary: Activity-only retained selected-detail model/handles keyed by selected sequence. Update existing fields/exact code when appropriate; preserve existing page-selection clearing, exact formatting/display cap and lifecycle cleanup. No shared Choice, disclosure or focus-engine change.
prioritized_findings.acceptance: Not implemented or authorized by this inventory

prioritized_findings.area: Shared header overflows with a valid long host name
prioritized_findings.evidence: At390px, the shared brand text reaches562.859375px and document width563. Activity/Host body fields, controls and native labels remain bounded. The111-character synthetic display_name is within the128-character cosmetic-name grammar.
prioritized_findings.cause: Both routes receive the same long status display_name through hostLabel; shared header brand text remains unbroken beyond its narrow allocation.
prioritized_findings.proposed_exact_boundary: Separate centrally allocated shell hostLabel/brand containment review. No Activity/Host body-width correction follows from this finding.
prioritized_findings.acceptance: Reported outside the body-specific correction boundary; no shell changes authorized
